title: Decision: Subscribe BEFORE reading store state in events handler
description:
In kithd events.rs events_handler (lines 149-156), subscription order is critical:
  1. Subscribe FIRST: let mut rx = state.events_tx.subscribe(); (line 152)
  2. Read store state SECOND: store.get_all_states() (line 180)

This prevents lost events:
  Any state change arriving between subscription and the state read will be delivered via the live stream. No events are lost even if store state advances during the get_all_states() query.

Comment at line 149 explicitly documents this invariant. The pattern is:
  subscribe() → read current state → compare to LEI → emit replay if needed → stream live events

Reversing this order would create a race: state could advance between read and subscribe, and the replay logic would miss it. This is a non-obvious correctness requirement in async programming.
